name: ModelVariant85_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant85_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to 32 spinning triangles open around a model part while the slots play backwards, a flickering sprite follows the part, and a burst sprite grows in front of the slot with a textured funnel behind it); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the triangle angles and spin speeds, builds the funnel rings and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the burst starts, 1 once at the hit and 2 after the burst ends; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
